title: Разговор в машине  (A Talk in the Car)

segments.t: Out in the courtyard, Viktor Barinov smashes a car window for psychological effect, climbs inside with Lyova, and warns the terrified young man never to set foot in Arcobaleno again—just before Elena Pavlovna walks into the courtyard!
Молодой человек, постойте, это для психологического эффекта!
Что вы делаете, немедленно уберите ваши руки!
Слушай меня внимательно, ты здесь работать не будешь!
Ты хорошо меня сейчас понял, молодой человек?
Если мы тебя здесь ещё раз увидим...
Вот этот повар сразу сломает тебе нос!
Лёва, скажи ему, ты ведь точно сломаешь?
И никому про наш разговор сегодня не говори!
Да, я всё понял, только отпустите меня!
Тихо, сядь на место, сюда идёт Елена!
Лёва, быстро садись в машину и не шуми!
Виктор Петрович, кажется, она нас сейчас заметит!
Let's break down Barinov's intimidation scene in the courtyard line by line.
Молодой человек, постойте, это для психологического эффекта!

'Young man, hold on, this is for psychological effect!' Once young man hold on this is for psychological effect, Barinov makes sure the guest hears every word. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Что вы делаете, немедленно уберите ваши руки!
'What are you doing, take your hands off me immediately!' Saying that what are Barinov doing take Barinov's hands off him immediately is how the guest takes charge of the moment.
Слушай меня внимательно, ты здесь работать не будешь!

'Listen to me carefully, you will not work here!' Barinov insists that to him carefully the guest will not work here, leaving the guest no room to argue. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Ты хорошо меня сейчас понял, молодой человек?

'Did you understand me well right now, young man?' By checking whether the guest understands him well right now young man, Barinov presses the guest for a straight answer. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Если мы тебя здесь ещё раз увидим...
'If we see you here one more time...' With the car and work in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Вот этот повар сразу сломает тебе нос!

'This cook right here will immediately break your nose!' Because this cook right here will immediately break the guest's nose, Barinov does not bother softening the blow for the guest. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Лёва, скажи ему, ты ведь точно сломаешь?

'Lyova, tell him, you will definitely break it, right?' Barinov asks whether tell him the guest will definitely break it right, refusing to let the point slide. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
И никому про наш разговор сегодня не говори!
'And do not tell anyone about our conversation today!' Once do not tell anyone about their conversation today, Barinov makes sure the guest hears every word.
Да, я всё понял, только отпустите меня!

'Yes, I understood everything, just let me go!' Declaring that he understood everything just let him go brings the guest's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Тихо, сядь на место, сюда идёт Елена!

'Quiet, sit in your seat, Elena is coming this way!' Barinov insists that quiet sit in the guest's seat Elena is coming this way, leaving the guest no room to argue. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Лёва, быстро садись в машину и не шуми!
'Lyova, get in the car quickly and do not make noise!' Once the guest should get in the car quickly and do not make noise, Barinov makes sure the guest hears every word.
Виктор Петрович, кажется, она нас сейчас заметит!

'Viktor Petrovich, it seems she is going to spot us right now!' Lyova declares that it seems she is going to spot them right now as the tension in the room peaks. Виктор Петрович, кажется, она нас сейчас заметит!
Leaving Lyova and the shaken newcomer crouched inside the car, Viktor Barinov steps out to greet Elena Pavlovna with a warm smile. Until next time!
Пока!
